memories.content: The user has a friend who has been through rehab multiple times and is exploring medication-assisted treatment because traditional therapy did not work.

dimension.reason: because traditional therapy did not work

memories.content: The user went on a 5-day hiking trip to Yellowstone National Park with friends in April 2023, hiking over 30 miles and seeing grizzly bears, wolves, and elk.
The user is interested in wildlife conservation, particularly for grizzly bears, wolves, and elk in Yellowstone National Park.
The user enjoys stargazing and prefers campsites with good stargazing opportunities.
The user is actively seeking resources to support their friend in exploring medication-assisted treatment.

dimension.reason: to help their friend find an effective treatment
dimension.purpose: to support the friend's recovery journey
